_comment: SARS 2026/27 individual income tax table (1 March 2026 – 28 February 2027). All monetary amounts are in integer South African cents (1/100 rand). Rates are in basis points (bps) where 10 000 bps = 100%. Primary threshold R99 000 → no tax below that income.
_bracketsNote: Band applies when income >= thresholdCents. Formula: tax = baseTaxCents + round((incomeCents - thresholdCents) * rateBps / 10000). R0-R245 900 @ 18%, R245 901-R383 900 @ 26%, R383 901-R532 000 @ 31%, R532 001-R698 100 @ 36%, R698 101-R890 100 @ 39%, R890 101-R1 886 900 @ 41%, R1 886 901+ @ 45%.
_rebatesNote: Primary (all natural persons): R17 820. Secondary (age 65–74): additional R9 774. Tertiary (age 75+): additional R3 267. Thresholds: <65 R99 000, 65–74 R153 300, 75+ R171 450.
_platformFeeNote: HustleHub+ platform fee deducted from gross income before tax calculation. 1000 bps = 10%.
_provisionalNote: IRP6 first provisional payment (50% of annual estimate) due 31 Aug 2026. Second payment (balance) due 28 Feb 2027. Voluntary top-up to avoid under-estimation penalty due 30 Sep 2027.
